question: Who was honoured with the National Kalidas Samman 2022 award for sitar playing?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Budhaditya Mukherjee**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Budhaditya Mukherjee** was honoured with the **National Kalidas Samman 2022** award for **sitar **playing.
 
• The National Kalidas Samman is a prestigious award presented annually by the Government of Madhya Pradesh in India.
 
• This award is given to artists in the fields of** classical music, classical dance, theatre, and visual arts**.
 
• Budhaditya Mukherjee is a renowned sitar player, known for his contributions to Indian classical music.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Budhaditya Mukherjee** was born on 16th September 1955 in Bhilai, Madhya Pradesh, India.
 
• He has received numerous awards and accolades for his exceptional talent and contributions to the field of music.
 
• Budhaditya Mukherjee belongs to the Imdadkhani gharana of classical music.
 
• He has performed at various prestigious platforms and has a significant impact on the promotion of Indian classical music globally.
